outcomes.promote_pr: Every required gate passes and no other gate in the verdict failed or is blocked.
outcomes.quarantine: Every required gate passes except that mutation_control is blocked, or stability_20 shows flakes within the flake budget. Nothing else may fail or be blocked.
outcomes.reject: Any required gate fails, any gate other than mutation_control is blocked or missing, the flake budget is exceeded, or the verdict is invalid.

blocked_gate_outcome.note: A blocked gate is never a pass. A rejection for a blocked gate is retryable once the blocker is removed.

rerun_schedule.note: A field carried on the quarantine record. No scheduler is implemented here.

unquarantine_rule.enforcement: policy value only; nothing in this directory schedules or counts runs

agent_verdict_override.statement: An agent verdict cannot override a gate failure. A gate result is whatever the gate module returned. A verdict that claims a better result than a supplied gate result is rejected, and the worse of the two always counts.
